response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY excess_over_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Scan count is the number of all scans in the group (COUNT(*)), including scans whose gbsize or spanmin is missing. Those scans are left out only of the ratio average.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing ratio (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero. Each group average is the average of per-scan ratios, not total gbsize divided by total spanmin.
The mean of all group averages is an unweighted mean over groups that have a non-null average. The scans-to-sites join is an inner join, so scans with no matching site are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Scan count includes only scans that contributed to the ratio, meaning those with non-missing gbsize and non-zero spanmin.
